summary: Go party, maybe kill your parents but we get it Bored as shit. Just a drink, Go out. We get it. Wanna dance drip in reality keeping time stolen from shattered pasts Painted on spilled futures. Your joy kills loved ones But we get it. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Go party,
maybe kill your
parents
but we get it
Bored as shit.
Just a drink,
Go out.
We get it.
Wanna dance
drip in
reality
keeping time
stolen from
shattered pasts
Painted on spilled
futures.
Your joy
kills loved ones
But we get it.
#smallpoems
